::: {#exr-write-in-matrix-form}

#### Write a rule in matrix form

A clinic scores a patient's risk from three measurements.

| symbol | meaning | units |
|---|---|---|
| $x_1$ | age | years |
| $x_2$ | systolic blood pressure | mmHg |
| $x_3$ | body mass index | kg/m$^2$ |

The rule in use is

$$\text{score} = 0.4\,x_1 + 0.2\,x_2 + 1.5\,x_3 - 30$$

Write this rule in the form of @eq-linear-scalar,
naming $\vec w$, $b$ and $p$ explicitly,
and give the score for a patient aged $50$ with blood pressure $130$ and BMI
$28$.

:::
